explanation: This unit tracks how late it is in the episode and ignores rewards: it sits at 0 through about trial 60, then climbs to about 1-2 by trials 65-80, 3-5 by trials 83-87, 6-9 by trial 90, and 8-10 over trials 93-99. Within each trial the D2 step is highest (about 1-3 points above D1, and 1-2 points higher again after a rare transition, near 10 late on), D1 comes next, and GO is lowest (about equal to D1 after choosing a1, but roughly half of D1 after choosing a2).
